cards.card_text: Raiders called the Sabeans swooped down, took the animals and put the servants to the sword.
cards.verse_text: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away.
cards.snippet: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD keeps speaking through the prophet Isaiah, to someone He calls "you." He says the products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, the land past Egypt's southern border (Ezekiel 29:10), along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to "you" and be yours.
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you.
cards.snippet: …“The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours;…

cards.verse_text: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
cards.snippet: …of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
